requirements.title: Rebase Sandbox to Current Repo State
requirements.description: Provide a rebase operation that updates sandbox's BaseCommitHash to current repo state. After rebase, conflict checks compare against the new base commit, and diffs are regenerated against current canonical repo state. Support 'regenerate' strategy that preserves sandbox changes while updating baseline.

requirements.title: Conflict and Rebase API Operations
requirements.description: HTTP operations for conflict checking and rebasing show conflict details, changed files, and actionable options. A separate CLI surface remains future work.

requirements.title: Force Approve Conflict Bypass
requirements.description: Approval requests support a force flag that bypasses conflict detection when operators explicitly accept the risk.

validation.notes: Service preflight honors force=true and bypasses conflict rejection
